clauses.label: Section 1.
clauses.text:
Section 1. The D irector o f the O ffice o f Personnel M anagem ent shall m ake 
arrangem ents for such national voluntary health and w elfare agencies and 
such other national voluntary agencies as m ay be appropriate to solicit 
contributions from Federal em ployees and m em bers o f the uniformed services 
at their places o f em ploym ent or duty. T hese arrangem ents shall take the form 
of an annual Com bined Federal Campaign in w hich eligible voluntary agen­
cies are authorized to take part.

clauses.label: S e c. 2.
clauses.text:
S e c. 2. The D irector shall establish  criteria for determining the eligibility of 
voluntary agencies that m ay participate in each  o f the annual Com bined 
Federal Campaigns.

clauses.label: S ec. 3.
clauses.text:
S ec. 3. In making arrangem ents for the Com bined Fed eral Campaign, the 
D irector is authorized, in his discretion, to consult w ith the D epartm ents and 
agencies concerned, representatives o f the em ployees and m em bers to be 
solicited, and, to the exten t p racticable, representatives o f voluntary agencies 
seeking to participate in a Com bined Fed eral Campaign.

clauses.label: S ec. 4.
clauses.text:
S ec. 4. The arrangem ents m ade by the D irector shall (a) ensure that all 
contributions are voluntary, that there is no coercion, and that individuals 
have the option o f disclosing their contribution or keeping it confidential, (b) 
designate the specific period during w hich the annual solicitation m ay be 
conducted, and (c) perm it only one annual solicitation excep t in cases of 
em ergency or d isaster appeals for w hich specific provision shall be m ade by 
the D irector.

clauses.label: Sec. 5.
clauses.text:
Sec. 5. Su b ject to such rules and regulations as he shall prescribe, the D irector 
m ay authorize a lo cal principal com bined fund organization to m anage a local 
Com bined Federal Campaign. Such authorization shall, if m ade, ensure at a 
minimum that the lo cal principal com bined fund organization operates su bject 
to the direction and control o f the D irector and such lo cal Federal coordinating 
entities as he m ay establish; m anages the lo cal cam paign fairly and equitably; 
consults with and considers advice from interested parties and organizations; 
and publishes reports of its m anagem ent of the lo cal cam paign.

clauses.label: Sec. 6.
clauses.text:
Sec. 6. The forms for the solicitation of funds shall clearly specify the eligible 
agencies and provide a direct m eans to designate funds to such agencies. 
W here allocation o f undesignated funds by the lo cal principal com bined fund 
organization is authorized by the D irector, prom inent notice of the authoriza­
tion for such allocation shall be provided on the solicitation forms.

clauses.label: S ec. 7.
clauses.text:
S ec. 7. This O rder shall not apply to solicitations conducted by organizations 
com posed of civilian em plpyees or m em bers o f the uniformed services among 
their ow n m em bers for organizational support or for the benefit o f w elfare 
funds for their m em bers. Such solicitations shall be conducted under policies 
and procedures approved by the head of th e D epartm ent or agency concerned.

versions.research_rationale:
Identity: the held Federal Register original (47 FR 12785, PDF pages 9-10) is Executive Order 12353 of March 23, 1982, Ronald Reagan, Charitable Fund-Raising (the Combined Federal Campaign). The packet inventory had three clauses (sections 1-4 lumped, 5, 6) and omitted sections 7, 8 and 9 and the preamble; it is corrected by overrides to ten clauses: preamble and sections 1 to 9. Later instruments: EO 12404 (February 10, 1983) replaced section 1, added subsection designation (a) and new subsection (b) principles to section 2, and continued existing rules; EO 13743 (October 13, 2016) changed agencies to voluntary health and welfare organizations in the preamble and sections 2 and 3, replaced sections 1, 5 and 6, rewrote section 2(b)(5), and continued existing rules. Current law: the held U.S. Code note under 5 U.S.C. 1101 prints the order as amended by those two orders only (release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09) with sections 3, 4, 7 and 8 unchanged and section 9 revoking Executive Order 10927; other Code notes (2 U.S.C. 4524, 4557 and 4558) cite it and the eCFR search found 19 mentions (leads only). No held instrument revokes it.
Member checks: {"earlier_end_check":"Searched the held corpus for the order's number: EDGES, the U.S. Code notes and the OFR notes show only EO 12404 and EO 13743 (both amendments) and a court-case See reference (Cornelius v. NAACP Legal Defense and Educational Fund, 473 U.S. 788 (1985), a decision upholding the order's exclusion rules, which does not end the order). The 2007 Federal Register rule E7-16986 (72 FR 49195) that the claim-drafts conflict list reads as a partial ending is a statement that EO 10927 was revoked by this order, not a revocation of this order. The chain items typed revoke for EO 12404 section 2 and EO 13743 section 2(d) are continuity clauses that keep rules issued under EO 12353 in effect until modified; they do not revoke the order. The order has no duration or sunset of its own.","independent_command_check":"Each section is an independent command and each was either amended in place (sections 1, 2, 3, 5, 6) or left unchanged (4, 7, 8, 9); none was ended. Section 9's revocation of EO 10927 stands and its saving of directives issued under that order continues until modified, which no held source shows to have happened.","savings_check":"No clause ended, so there is nothing to save; rules, regulations and directives issued under the order were expressly continued by EO 12404 section 2 and EO 13743 section 2(d) until revoked or modified, and the bounded searches name no revocation.","scope_check":"Ten clauses: the preamble, and sections 1 (OPM Director arranges the annual Combined Federal Campaign), 2 (eligibility criteria), 3 (consultation), 4 (arrangement requirements: voluntary contributions, solicitation period, one solicitation a year), 5 (local campaign authority), 6 (solicitation forms), 7 (exclusion of member solicitations by employee organizations), 8 (Director to prescribe rules) and 9 (revocation of EO 10927 with a saving of its directives). All remain in force as amended."}

reviews.reasons: Quotes and hashes exact; identity (Reagan, March 23, 1982, Charitable Fund-Raising) agrees; the ten-clause inventory is complete; each clause's later events match EO 12404 and EO 13743 exactly, and the 5 U.S.C. 1101 note supports a continuing predicate for every clause. The FR catalog notes (Revokes EO 10927; Amended by EO 12404, EO 13743; See Cornelius) are all addressed and none ends the order. The outcome looks right, but the research rationale states that the current Code note prints section 3 unchanged, contradicting EO 13743 section 1(h), the note itself and the claim's own section 3 clause. Under the rule that every fact in the rationale must match the sources, the internal inconsistency requires rejection; the packet-inventory description is also slightly wrong.
